args.root_cause: `Page.total_pages` uses floor division (`//`) instead of ceiling division. With 11 items and page_size 5, `11 // 5 = 2`, so the trailing partial page (item 11) is not counted. Because `has_next` is defined as `page_number < total_pages`, it returns False on page 2 and the "next" control disappears one page early, making the last partial page unreachable. The slicing in `paginate` is correct; only the page count is wrong. The fix is to round up, e.g. `-(-self.total_items // self.page_size)` or `math.ceil(self.total_items / self.page_size)`.
